The main protagonist of Jujutsu Kaisen prequel series [Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School](https://anilist.co/manga/105469/Tokyo-Toritsu-Jujutsu-Kodo-Senmon-Gakko). He was initially a Special Grade Cursed Victim haunted by his late childhood friend, [Rika Orimoto](https://anilist.co/character/208533/Orimoto-Rika). [Satoru Gojou](https://anilist.co/character/127691/Satoru-Gojou) mentored Yuuta and enrolled him at Tokyo Jujutsu High.
